# `compat/schema-registry.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/schema-registry.js`

schema-registry.js — validate a compatibility profile before boot. Self-contained: a tiny JSON-Schema-subset checker (type / required / enum / properties / items / additionalProperties) plus `validateProfile()` which also applies cross-field consistency rules (e.g. GPU pipelines imply uses.webgpu). The bootloader calls this via `ctx.validate`; Package Studio can call `engine.compat.validateProfile(profile)` to preview problems before compiling.
